record.one_liner: Open-source ecommerce plugin that adds a store, products, orders and customers to WordPress.
record.auth_notes: Keys (Consumer Key/Secret) are generated per WordPress user in WooCommerce settings and sent as HTTP Basic auth over HTTPS. Over plain HTTP, docs require OAuth 1.0a one-legged signing (HMAC-SHA1/SHA256 with key+secret), which is classed as other. WooCommerce does not use OAuth 2.0.
record.access_notes: Store admin generates REST API keys in WordPress admin; no WooCommerce API paywall seen in fetched docs. Plan-level pricing of the hosting provider was not checked.
record.api_notes: Versioned REST namespace wc/v3 (e.g. orders endpoint). Breadth is a judgement from the documented resource set; not enumerated object by object.
